cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Paytm Mobile card offering cashback and rewards on mobile recharges, bill payments, and Paytm ecosystem spends, ideal for digital-first users.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 20% discount on partner restaurants via Dineout when using your HDFC Bank Credit Card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at 20,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC Paytm Mobile credit card to unlock the offer.
